text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for Нарита Таисин's debut
race!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: However, she seems very uneasy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Want to do some breathing exercises with me?

text_block_list.text:
Bug off. I'm not scared or anything. Got
it?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин! Please make your way to
the
paddock!
text_block_list.name: Race Attendant

text_block_list.text: Oh... Right, okay.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Well, see ya later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
As she leaves, I can see her legs are
trembling
ever so slightly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: (What can I do to encourage her?)

text_block_list.text:
Spectators crowd about, eager to catch
a glimpse
of the Umamusume in the
paddock who may one
day become
legends in their own right.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I spot Нарита Таисин standing among her
fellow
racers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's up with that one over there?
She's
pretty darn tiny...
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Does she even stand a chance with that
stature?
Seems like she could get blown
away.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
I-Is she going to be okay? I hope she
doesn't get
hurt...
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text: Tch.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
No one seems to expect much from her.
She
hangs her head down amid the
murmuring voices
whirling around her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No one can deny that her lack of height
is a
disadvantage when it comes to
racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"You're too short!" "You're too frail!"
"You're not
cut out to be a racer!"
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
All that junk—I'm sick and tired of
hearing it!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Okay?! I don't care what people say! I'm
gonna
stay right on the turf! I'll show all
you whiny
morons!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'll show you exactly where I should be!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
And I'll be laughing when I tell you to
shove it
from the winner's circle!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин is stronger and more
determined to
win than anyone, and she
has the ability to make
all her
declarations come true.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I know this better than
anyone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm shouting before I realize what I'm
doing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, stop yelling! Seriously!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Geez, what are we doing? We should be
cheering
her on. It's her debut, after all.
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Go get 'em, Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: We're behind you all the way!
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text: Look what that idiot started!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
First, I'm going to win, then I'm kicking
that
doofus to the other side of the
world!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
